{{Quote|Jacen and I have been trying to come up with just the perfect gift for Mom's birthday.|[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]|<ref name="SHA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shards of Alderaan]]''</ref>}}
[[File:RItes_Kneesaa_birthday.png|thumb|right|250px|Princess Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka during one of her birthday's parties]]
'''Birthdays''', also known as '''borndays''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[OrulShai III]],<ref name="TAB-SB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> were anniversaries celebrated by beings, particularly [[Human/Legends|Humans]], on the day of their births. A party was generally held on said day. People often gave special gifts to the person celebrating their birthday. One example of this was during the [[Rebellion era]], the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] received her [[ruling staff]] on her birthday from her father, [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]]. On that day Chirpa had chosen Kneesaa as the future Chief of their Ewok tribe, and the staff symbolized this.<ref name="rites">[[Ewoks (1985) 2|''Ewoks'' (1985) 2]]</ref> Another example was, in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] traveled to [[the Graveyard]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to get a piece of asteroid for [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|their mother's]] forty-third birthday.<ref name="SHA" />

Examples of birthdays are [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and Leia's birthday, which occurred on the 24th day of the 5th month of the [[Great ReSynchronization]] (one day after [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]]), [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin's]] birthday, which occurred on the fourth month of the Great ReSynchronization, and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] birthday, which occurred on the 11th day of the 8th month of the Great ReSynchronization.
